scenes.setting: Tuesday morning walk to the mailbox: Mrs. Doris at the oriel window with Brody the black cat (who friend-zones his rescuer); Klein's Spirit Vision reads her failing lungs — she needs the south, Desi Bay — then the Stuart letter goes in the box: the performance's prelude
scenes.text_anchor: “When Jurgen comes back, I’ll have him pay you!”

scenes.setting: An anxious carriage outside 15 Minsk Street: Ma'am Mary's threatening letter — a dismembered doll and a demand to go easy on factory smoke — while Stelyn sits oddly dejected; Klein's coin-flip divination finds NO danger and he predicts someone will come wanting to make it public
scenes.text_anchor: “Detective Moriarty, I received a threatening letter!”

scenes.setting: Ma'am Mary barely home before Hibbert Hall, the council's chief secretary's son, arrives asking her to give a reporter interview to publicize the outrage — exactly as Detective Moriarty described
scenes.text_anchor: It’s exactly as Detective Moriarty described…

scenes.setting: After breakfast, above the gray fog without delay this time: preparing to divine the origin of the Biological Poison Bottle
scenes.text_anchor: This time, he didn’t delay it at all.
